definitions.explanation: A medical facility specializing in dental care. In Japan, most dental practices are small private clinics rather than large hospital departments.

examples.japanese: {歯科医院|しかいいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I made an appointment at the dental clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{歯科医院|しかいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A new dental clinic opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧{歯科医院|しかいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{閉院|へいいん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧らしい。
examples.english: The dental clinic I've been going to since childhood is apparently closing next month.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧ (dentistry) + ⟦{医院|いいん}→医院：01778_iin⟧ (clinic). The standard term for a private dental practice in Japan. Japan has one of the highest densities of dental clinics in the world, with over 60,000 nationwide.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯科医院|しかいいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to visit a dental clinic regularly
- {歯科医院|しかいいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to make a dental appointment
- {歯科医院|しかいいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive treatment at a dental clinic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧: dentist — the casual, everyday word; also used to refer to the clinic itself colloquially
- ⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧: dentistry — the field itself, or used as a prefix (e.g., ⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧ = dentist)
- ⟦{医院|いいん}→医院：01778_iin⟧: clinic — a general medical clinic; {歯科医院|しかいいん} specifies dental
